samples.summaryVi: Nghỉ ngắn giúp đổi nhịp học; cần quy trình rõ để không phá vỡ tiết học.

paragraphs.label: Mở thư và nhận lời
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

Thank you for your invitation to a healthy study habits session. I am pleased to accept and would welcome the opportunity to take part. I appreciate the time you have spent making the arrangements.

paragraphs.template:
Dear [danh xưng và họ người nhận],

Thank you for your invitation to [sự kiện / hoạt động]. I am pleased to accept and would welcome the opportunity to take part. I appreciate the time you have spent making the arrangements.

paragraphs.label: Xác nhận sắp xếp
paragraphs.text: I understand that the event will take place at the local library on Saturday at two in the afternoon. I will plan my journey accordingly. Please let me know if there are any changes to the time or location.
paragraphs.noteVi: Xác nhận thông tin người mời đã đưa.

on

paragraphs.template: I understand that the event will take place at [địa điểm] on [ngày và giờ]. I will plan my journey accordingly. Please let me know if there are any changes to the time or location.

paragraphs.label: Chuẩn bị và hỗ trợ
paragraphs.text: I am particularly interested in the opportunity to test a study routine with short planned breaks. One reason is that students can return to work with better attention. I can bring a timer, but I would be grateful if you could confirm whether anything else is required. I would also be happy to assist with the preparations if needed.
